name: Voxel Data Interpolation and Sampling
definition: A method to retrieve scalar values, gradients, and transformed colors at arbitrary 3D positions within the volume grid, supporting different interpolation modes and transformation modes.
summary: Voxel Data Interpolation and Sampling retrieves scalar and gradient values at arbitrary 3D positions, distinguished by providing low-level access primitives for higher-level shading models rather than defining basis functions.
